blind.description: A carved architectural corbel or wall bracket in the Green Man motif. It consists of a flat, rectangular wooden top shelf supported by an ornate bracket depicting a bearded face emerging from green leaves and curling acanthus scrollwork, with a flat vertical back for wall mounting. The surfaces are continuous, solid, and sculpted cleanly with painted wood textures in brown and olive-green.
blind.from_above: A plain rectangular brown shelf surface.
defects: floats unsupported in mid-air (wall-mounted asset rendered without a wall)
